MiniMax H3 RefMod Builder - Images Video.description: Build a reusable RefMod bundle from the prompt uploader: add photos of one character, video, audio, or a mixture. Set MiniMax H3 RefMod Name and click Generate. The backend runs only the video/audio VAEs, saves a safetensors bundle in models/refmods, and returns a source preview. Refresh the RefMod picker to use it in any H3 preset. One character stacks photos; Separate references preserves individual pictures. No compression is the default. Existing files receive numbered names. Requires MiniMaxH3References 1.19.0 and updated FoleyExtension.
